source_review.title: Rapamycin and healthspan: a systematic review and meta-analysis

conclusion_summary: Rapamycin shows directional healthspan benefit in preclinical and limited human data; safety profile at healthspan doses acceptable in short term.
limitations: Limited long-term human safety data at healthspan doses
Biomarker endpoints, not clinical outcome data

quantitative_claims.claim: 11% increase in median lifespan in mice at 14ppm dosing
7-10% improvement in physical function in older adults at 5mg weekly
14% reduction in markers of aging in human trials
